notes: The opening עַל carries the verbless clause's supplied copula under rule 49, the explicit הוּא taking only its own *it*.
בְּנָגְעוֹ is divided under rule 52: *when* to the preposition, *toucheth* to the infinitive, *he* to its suffixed subject under rule 18; the following בּוֹ leaves the preposition unrepresented.
